name: Liquid CO2 carriers
applications: CCS where storage is far from capture
principle: Ships carry liquefied CO2 at about -50 °C and 7 bar in semi-refrigerated tanks. The IPCC report (2005) puts loss at 3 to 4% per 1,000 km and finds ships competitive with pipelines at about 1,000 km for 6 Mt/yr; Northern Lights stores 1.5 Mt/yr in phase 1, about 2,600 m below the North Sea seabed.
